sentences.text: This is an application under Section 397/401 of the CrPC challenging the order Page No.# 2/2 dated 29.10.2022 and the other subsequent orders passed by the learned JMFC, Lakhimpur in GR Case No. 1726/2021.
The petitioner has been shown as absconder in the charge sheet filed under Section 417/376 IPC and the learned trial court immediately issued NBWA against the petitioner.
It appears that the learned court below has committed an error by issuing NBWA at the first instance instead of issuing summons.
Therefore, the impugned order dated 29.10.2022 and the other subsequent orders passed by the learned JMFC, Lakhimpur in GR Case No. 1726/2021 are hereby set aside.

The petitioner is directed to approach the learned trial court on 29.05.2023 and on that day, he shall file regular bail application and the learned court below shall consider the same in accordance with the procedure laid down by law.
With the above direction, the revision petition is disposed of.
